maddeler.e:
تفارقت (form VI)
# تَفَارَقْتُ (tafāraqtu) /ta.faː.raq.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَفَارَقَ (tafāraqa)
# تَفَارَقْتَ (tafāraqta) /ta.faː.raq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَفَارَقَ (tafāraqa)
# تَفَارَقْتِ (tafāraqti) /ta.faː.raq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَفَارَقَ (tafāraqa)
# تَفَارَقَتْ (tafāraqat) /ta.faː.ra.qat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
